audit_report.root_cause_claim_text: 2-year revenue CAGR from FY2020 to FY2022 calculated as 8.2%
audit_report.rationale: The CAGR calculation is mathematically incorrect. Using the formula CAGR = (Ending Value / Beginning Value)^(1/n) - 1, the correct calculation is (65984/56398)^(1/2) - 1 = 0.0812 or 8.12%, which rounds to 8.1% to one decimal place, not 8.2%. The error originated in the analyst stage where the CAGR was miscalculated.
